claims.quote: Only if counter collection is chosen: after completing registration, present the fictional registration reference at the fictional counter to collect the demo pack.
Only if locker collection is chosen: after completing registration, use the fictional registration reference at the fictional locker to collect the demo pack.

Register a fictional collection request and obtain its fictional registration reference. Registration and collection both have a fictional fee of LKR 0. After registration, choose exactly one collection method: counter or locker. Use the registration reference with the chosen method. Do not perform both alternatives.

heading.text: Use the counter route with your registration reference

essential.text: Only if counter collection is chosen: after completing registration, present the fictional registration reference at the fictional counter to collect the demo pack.

remainder.text: This route applies only when counter collection is chosen.

The counter and locker instructions describe alternative ways to collect the same fictional pack. On this route you present the registration reference at the counter after registration; the locker route is not an additional required visit.

recap.text: Earlier counter guidance applied only to the counter choice and required the registration reference.

heading.text: Use the locker route with your registration reference

essential.text: Only if locker collection is chosen: after completing registration, use the fictional registration reference at the fictional locker to collect the demo pack.

remainder.text: This route applies only when locker collection is chosen.

The locker route uses the registration reference after registration. Counter collection is the other alternative, not another action required after this route. The chosen route determines where you use the reference.

recap.text: Earlier locker guidance applied only to the locker choice and required the registration reference.

heading.text: Register your collection request and keep its reference

essential.text: Register a fictional collection request and obtain its fictional registration reference. Registration and collection both have a fictional fee of LKR 0. After registration, choose exactly one collection method: counter or locker. Use the registration reference with the chosen method. Do not perform both alternatives.

remainder.text: After registration, choose one collection method.

Registration supplies the reference used by either collection method. Counter and locker collection are alternatives, so the reference connects registration to your chosen method; it does not mean you must visit both.

recap.text: Earlier guidance asked you to register, obtain the reference and choose one collection method.

phases.why_grouped: Registration produces the reference for either collection route.
Both actions belong to one alternative collection choice, not two visits.
